title: Platypus Ka Ajab Sach
idea: Platypuses do not have stomachs, and their esophagus connects directly to their intestines.

lines.text: Kya aapko pata hai is anokhe jaanwar ka pet hi nahi hota?
Socho, agar humara pet na ho toh khana kahan jayega?
Platypus ka esophagus seedha intestines se juda hota hai!
Iska matlab iske paas pepsin paida karne wale genes hi nahi hain.
Inke paas bas ek pouch jaisa section hota hai jo khana pachane mein madad karta hai.
Kya aapko is hairan karne wale fact ka pata tha? Comments mein batao!
